prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 个人所得税专项附加扣除标准简表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "扣除项目" spans 1 col × 2 row; "每月标准（元）" spans 2 col × 1 row; "适用条件" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "扣除项目" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 133px
  col 2: header "每月标准（元） › 一般地区" · longest unbreakable word 37px · one-line width 203px
  col 3: header "每月标准（元） › 特殊情形" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 435px
  col 4: header "适用条件" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 1038px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总个人所得税专项附加扣除的月度标准及适用条件，供读者按扣除项目查询。","reading":"读者先在首列找到项目，再横向比较一般地区与特殊情形的标准，最后查看适用条件；各行需要保持清晰的横向联系。","groups":["第二、三列同属“每月标准（元）”，分别列出一般地区和特殊情形，应便于横向比较；特殊情形包含更多解释，需要更多空间。","首列与同一行的标准和条件共同构成一个查询单元，换行后仍应容易辨认行与项目的对应关系。"],"keep_intact":["2000、400、1000、1500、3000、1100或800等金额及数字组合","50%、3600元/年等比例和金额单位","扣除项目名称应尽量完整显示，尤其是较长的“3岁以下婴幼儿照护”"],"may_wrap":["适用条件中的完整说明可按语义自然换行。","特殊情形中的括号说明可换行，金额应尽量留在句首。","一般地区中的地区或身份说明可换行；相同行的其他单元格可利用由条件说明产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [125, 145, 190, 259] · table 720×803px · row heights [36, 36, 106, 106, 129, 129, 129, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [125, 105, 250, 239] · table 720×849px · row heights [36, 36, 129, 129, 129, 129, 129, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [105, 145, 145, 324] · table 720×686px · row heights [36, 36, 106, 83, 106, 106, 106, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"项目列较易扫描；一般地区和特殊情形有适当区分，金额和说明的对应关系清楚。表头完整，数字组合没有被拆开。","problems":"适用条件密集且多行，后四个数据行明显偏高；特殊情形列在若干较短内容的行中留白较多。较长项目名称仍需换行。","cause":"适用条件列为259px，承载最长的说明，成为多数行的高度瓶颈；项目列125px不足以容纳最长名称。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"特殊情形列较宽，括号说明较容易阅读；表头和数字组合保持完整。","problems":"表格最高，适用条件几乎每行都显得拥挤；一般地区中的地区说明被切成许多短行，两个标准子列的宽度也失衡。较长项目名称仍需换行。","cause":"250px分给特殊情形列，但适用条件列仅239px、一般地区列仅105px，使两列频繁换行；项目列125px仍不足以容纳最长名称。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"适用条件较从容，多数行高度降低，横向查阅条件更顺畅；两个标准子列宽度相同，表头完整，数字组合没有被拆开。","problems":"项目名称换行较多，尤其“住房贷款利息”末字单独落在下一行；特殊情形中的解释也较碎，削弱了金额与说明的整体性。","cause":"项目列只有105px，特殊情形列只有145px；较大的条件列占用了可用于这两列的空间。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balance-c","widths":[125,130,165,299],"change":"以r0C为基础，将项目列和特殊情形列加宽，减少项目名称及括号说明的零碎换行；条件列保留299px，兼顾说明的可读性和行高。"},{"name":"intact-label","widths":[154,115,160,290],"change":"优先为最长项目名称提供接近单行所需的宽度，让首列更便于定位；一般地区列适度收窄，条件列仍保持较宽，观察名称完整性与说明换行的取舍。"},{"name":"conditions-first","widths":[120,120,165,314],"change":"保留较宽的条件列，同时比r0C增加项目列和特殊情形列的宽度；从一般地区列让出空间，测试能否在维持较低行高的同时改善两列的断行。"}]}
